film.title: The Grizzly's Forest
film.logline: A naive girl walks a sunlit forest among animals and birds; at dusk a grizzly appears under brief clouds, but she keeps it calm and friendly.
film.style: warm nature documentary, natural available light, golden hour into dusk
film.world: a dense deciduous forest, mossy trails, tall pines, dappled sun turning to cool blue dusk
film.palette: warm amber daylight fading to cool teal dusk, earthy browns and leaf greens

scenes.title: The Forest
scenes.prose: A young girl walks slowly through a sunlit forest, birds lifting off the branches, a deer watching from the undergrowth; as the light cools into dusk and brief clouds gather, a grizzly rises from the shadows and she gently keeps it calm and friendly.

shots.prose: wide shot, the girl walks down a sunlit forest corridor, birds scatter from the pines, a deer stands watching, lens flare threads through the leaves, warm golden light
medium-low shot, a grizzly emerges as brief clouds gather and the light cools; the girl lowers her arms and stays still, the bear approaches, she soothes it and it settles calm and friendly
